text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Good morning, Trainer-dono.
As per your instructions, I have rested thoroughly and recovered.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"Rest is part of training" is truly a wise maxim.
I feel my mind and body are incomparably more refreshed
than before the break.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"Today's training shall also bear fruit.
Well then, until later!"

It looks like Yaeno Muteki was able to
get some solid rest!
